types.label: Data backup failed or late
types.description: The axf-data backup failed its verify, or the newest one is over a day old (the axf-data systems check item, which also runs the Auto fix). One alert per episode; a tap opens Settings → Plugins → Data store.

types.label: Data drift in shadow
types.description: A namespace in shadow mode logged a difference between the local files and axf-data (or a mirror write failed): the cutover waits until it is read and accepted. A tap opens the drift log.
